newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian banks '96 profits seen up more than 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Belgian banks '96 profits seen up more than 10 pct.

text.p: The Belgian banking sector's 1996 profits should grow on average by more than 10 percent due to last year's low interest rates and steep yield curve, Belgian Banking Association chairman Willy Breesch said on Wednesday.
"Profit growth in the sector should be better than in 1995. I think 1996 profits will show growth of more than 10 percent on average," he told Reuters in an interview.
"But that is not a structural growth. Commercial margins remain under pressure. The profit growth is due to the favourable interest rate climate we enjoyed last year," he added.
